description: Rosso--Jones decomposition of embeddable torus knots on Σ₄ for beta decay Q-values. The 6 embeddable torus knots {T_{2,3}, T_{2,5}, T_{2,7}, T_{3,5}, T_{2,9}, T_{3,4}} form a complete, self-dual basis for the Hilbert space of H_n(q). Degree factors F_k are computed via Markov traces of J(T)·T·Δ_mix products.
caveats: Degree factors F_k are universal (same for all nuclei). The product ∏ F_k collapses the full spectral decomposition.
Method 2 (bare × F₂) is the standard approach. F₁ is degree-1 and already encoded in Q_bare via crossing weights. Method 2 applies the degree-2 correction only.
